title: Lil bro yelling at the family 💀 #shorts #robloxanimation

hook.why: A screeching tantrum on the audio, then rapid-fire reaction shots of each family member arming themselves. The premise and the promised payoff both land inside three seconds.

scenes.action: A blonde Roblox kid stomps and screams. Cutaways show Dad with a remote, Big Bro pulling off headphones, and Noob in the hallway all reacting.
scenes.dialogue: "Lil bro yelling at the family" (on-screen text)
scenes.camera: Series of quick cuts; medium shots across several rooms
scenes.visual: Blonde avatar screaming in a modern kitchen, then fast cuts to the rest of the family.

scenes.action: Dad pulls off his leather belt, folds it in his hands, and steps forward.
scenes.visual: Stern angular-faced avatar in a living room holding a black belt.

scenes.action: Mom stomps down the hallway wielding two slippers.
scenes.camera: Medium tracking pan following her down the corridor
scenes.visual: Avatar with glasses and long brown hair, angry grimace, a slipper in each hand.

scenes.action: Big Bro steps forward holding a plastic clothes hanger like a weapon.
scenes.visual: Avatar in sunglasses, cap and hoodie, hanger raised.

scenes.action: The classic Noob avatar charges down the hallway with an exaggerated run cycle and rapid face changes.
scenes.camera: Wide low-angle tracking straight down the hallway, character running at camera
scenes.visual: Yellow-and-blue Noob sprinting erratically toward the viewer.
